title: Retrieval eval for the course tutor: chunking, recall@k, MRR and a CI gate
scenario: Before anyone judges generated tutor answers, Kestrel needs to know whether the right lesson section comes back. Build the offline harness that runs in CI: two chunking strategies, a course-filtered index, section-level recall@k and MRR, and a gate against a stored baseline, on two open courses with 32 labeled questions.
task: Fixed-size-with-overlap and heading-aware chunkers that keep citation metadata
Top-k search filtered to the learner's course before ranking
Section-level recall@k and MRR with dedupe
An evaluate report and a CI gate with reasons
acceptance: Hand-computed metric cases and exact chunk windows
Heading-aware beats fixed on MRR; the CLI gate passes
ANSWER.md interprets the numbers and plans next steps

practices.label: Week 5 Thu - retrieval metrics and CI gates
